findings.problem: AC12 says a 'freshly instantiated worksheet for TPL-A6D-0002 opens the linearity group with nine rows', but create_worksheet rejects non-Active templates (is_selectable == status ACTIVE) and TPL-A6D-0002 is Draft, so a literal create_worksheet call would raise. The Testability section already reframes AC12 as an evaluate({}, {}) blank-sheet test, but the AC12 prose does not.
findings.fix: Reword AC12 to assert TemplateDefinition.parse + WorksheetEvaluator.evaluate({}, {}) gives has_blocking_failure == False and linearity.rows.default == 9 with no field default, instead of a create_worksheet call on a Draft row.

findings.problem: FR3 states the group 'opens with nine blank rows' as if a backend guarantee. Backend evaluate({}, {}) and create_worksheet (group_values={}) store no rows; the nine-row open is produced by the frontend row builder reading rows.default (WorksheetForm.tsx).
findings.fix: Add to FR3: '(the nine-row open is produced by the frontend row builder reading rows.default; the stored definition and backend evaluator hold no rows).'

findings.problem: time_points_min is type:text with unit:'min'. Parses fine, but a unit on a free-text list field is display-only and may render oddly.
findings.fix: Optional: drop unit:'min' and fold it into the label ('Time Points (min)'), or leave as-is.
